craptech_cluster_page.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechCluster') if c then c.nextPage() end
craptech_cluster_page.title: Cluster: next page
craptech_cluster_page.desc: The digital cluster's middle: map, trip computer or engine readings (a click on the screen)

craptech_cluster_trip.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechCluster') if c then c.resetTrip() end
craptech_cluster_trip.title: Cluster: reset the trip
craptech_cluster_trip.desc: The digital cluster's trip computer starts again (a middle click on the screen)
